beats.say: Walter Koenig was one of only two Chekov auditioners.
Most people assume a major Star Trek role draws hundreds of hopefuls.
Yet the part went to a Chicago native born in 1936.
The same source says he later stood as best man at George Takei's wedding in 2008.
